SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, count(distinct s.store_id) stores, sum(net_amount) net
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sale_date=d.calendar_date LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key AND s.store_id<900
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 3

WITH movements AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS movement_date, f.net_amount AS amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
),
weekly AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, round(sum(m.amount), 2) AS net_sales
  FROM movements m JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = m.movement_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT t.fiscal_year, t.fiscal_period, t.fiscal_week,
       t.net_sales AS net_sales_this_year,
       p.fiscal_year AS prior_fiscal_year,
       p.net_sales AS net_sales_last_year,
       round(100.0 * (t.net_sales - p.net_sales) / p.net_sales, 2) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly t JOIN weekly p ON p.fiscal_week = t.fiscal_week AND p.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE t.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY t.fiscal_week
